beckett sennecke.note: Sennecke (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

ryan poehling.note: Poehling (knee) is on the Ducks' current road trip and has resumed skating, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Thursday.

aj greer.note: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

james hagens.note: Hagens (back) is wearing a non-contact sweater ahead of Tuesday's practice, Steve Conroy of the Boston Herald reports.

tyson kozak.note: Kozak (undisclosed) did not practice Tuesday and is considered day-to-day, per Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550.

justin danforth.note: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

matt grzelcyk.note: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

morgan frost.note: Frost sustained an upper-body injury during Monday's 2-1 loss to the Senators, and head coach Ryan Huska did not have an update on the center's status after the game, Flames TV host Brendan Parker reports.

martin pospisil.note: Pospisil (upper body) didn't travel with his teammates for the start of Calgary's five-game road trip, per Eric Francis of Sportsnet on Monday.

jonathan huberdeau.note: Huberdeau (hip) had three assists in AHL Calgary's 4-3 win over Coachella Valley on Wednesday.

kevin bahl.note: Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.

connor bedard.note: Bedard underwent successful shoulder surgery Monday and is expected to make a full recovery in approximately four months, the Blackhawks announced.

wyatt kaiser.note: Kaiser was suspended for three games by the NHL Department of Player Safety on Sunday for an illegal check to the head against Calgary's Martin Pospisil (upper body) on Saturday.

bowen byram.note: Byram (upper body) didn't accompany his teammates on Chicago's three-game road trip, per Mark Lazerus of The Athletic on Saturday.

cale makar.note: Makar (lower body) was on the ice in a regular sweater ahead of Wednesday's clash with Montreal, Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette reports.

nathan mackinnon.note: MacKinnon (lower body) has been evaluated by a specialist and is expected to miss the next 12 weeks, Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now reports Saturday.

tyler myers.note: Myers (upper body) has a chance to return in Wednesday's home clash against the Predators, per Robert Tiffin of NHL.com.

oskar back.note: Back (finger) is expected to return within the next week, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports Thursday.

kyle capobianco.note: Capobianco (leg) was moved to long-term injured reserve Saturday.

lian bichsel.note: Bichsel (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

matt duchene.note: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.

sam montembeault.note: Montembeault (lower body), Kirby Dach, Michael Hage, a 2027 first-round pick, a 2029 first-round pick, a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fourth-round pick were traded to the Red Wings from the Canadiens on Sunday in exchange for Dylan Larkin, a 2028 second-round pick and a 2027 third-round pick.

simon edvinsson.note: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

alec regula.note: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

matt savoie.note: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

frederik andersen.note: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

mattias janmark.note: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

brad marchand.note: Marchand (knee) is close to returning to the lineup, but he won't play against Buffalo on Saturday, per Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site.

aleksander barkov.note: Barkov (knee) won't play against Buffalo on Saturday, but he could return within Florida's next three games, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

jonah gadjovich.note: Gadjovich (neck) took the ice Thursday in a non-contact sweater, George Richards of Florida Hockey Now reports.

erik gustafsson.note: Gustafsson (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.

mike matheson.note: Matheson (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Tuesday, Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports reports.

ivan demidov.note: General manager Kent Hughes said Monday that Demidov (ankle) will not travel with the team for Wednesday's game in Colorado, Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports reports.

josh anderson.note: Anderson (lower body) will be out for approximately 3-4 weeks, per Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Sunday.

anthony mantha.note: Mantha (neck) is expected to miss about one month after undergoing surgery, per Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News.

johnathan kovacevic.note: Kovacevic (ankle) is expected to be sidelined for 4-6 weeks, per Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News.

seamus casey.note: Casey (knee) was moved to long-term injured reserve on Friday, per PuckPedia.

ryan pulock.note: Pulock (shoulder) is expected to miss 1-2 weeks, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports Tuesday.

pavel dorofeyev.note: Dorofeyev (lower body) will join the Rangers for their two-game road trip, Mollie Walker of the New York Post reports Tuesday.

oliver bjorkstrand.note: Bjorkstrand (upper body) is expected to be sidelined for 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reports Saturday.

alberts smits.note: Smits (upper body) is expected to miss 2-3 months, Peter Baugh of The Athletic reported Saturday.

joe veleno.note: Veleno (lower body) skated on his own before Friday's practice session, Colin Stephenson of Newsday reports.

igor shesterkin.note: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

andre burakovsky.note: Burakovsky (lower body) will be with the Senators for their four-game road trip and is expected to play at some point, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Wednesday.

warren foegele.note: Head coach Travis Green said Monday that Foegele (knee) hasn't yet resumed skating, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports.

william eklund.note: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

nikita grebenkin.note: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

bryan rust.note: Rust (lower body) is skating in a non-contact sweater Friday, Seth Rorabaugh of Tribune-Review Sports reports.

elmer soderblom.note: Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.

ryan graves.note: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

kiefer sherwood.note: Sherwood (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

igor chernyshov.note: Head coach Ryan Warsofsky said Sunday that Chernyshov (upper body) is not close to returning to game action, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

quentin musty.note: Head coach Ryan Warsofsky said Sunday that Musty (upper body) isn't close to returning, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

kyle keyser.note: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

jake obrien.note: The Kraken indicated Thursday that O'Brien (lower body) remains week-to-week, Mike Benton of the Kraken Audio Network reports.

jared mccann.note: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

jimmy snuggerud.note: Snuggerud (undisclosed) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Islanders, per Lou Korac of NHL.com.

torey krug.note: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

tyler tucker.note: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

conor geekie.note: Geekie (shoulder) underwent surgery Monday and is expected to miss 4-5 months.

brandon hagel.note: Hagel (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Lightning on Thursday, retroactive to Nov. 15, Eduardo A. Encina of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

colton sissons.note: Sissons (lower body) is day-to-day, per David Alter of The Hockey News on Sunday.

kirill marchenko.note: Marchenko (lower body) is day-to-day, according to David Alter of The Hockey News on Saturday.

cole mcward.note: McWard (lower body) is considered day-to-day, per David Alter of The Hockey News on Saturday.

nick blankenburg.note: Blankenburg (upper body) is day-to-day, according to David Alter of The Hockey News on Saturday.

miles wood.note: Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

max domi.note: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

elvis merzlikins.note: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

john marino.note: Marino (upper body) likely won't return during Utah's four-game road trip, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News on Monday.

michael carcone.note: Carcone (upper body) will be out of action for 3-4 months, Catherine Bogart of the Mammoth's official site reports Monday.

nate schmidt.note: The Mammoth announced Thursday that Schmidt (upper body) is considered week-to-week, Cole Bagley of KSL Sports reports.

brendan gallagher.note: Gallagher (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

thatcher demko.note: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

vincent desharnais.note: Desharnais (appendectomy) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice and has been upgraded to day-to-day, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports.

rasmus sandin.note: Sandin (knee) has been cleared to start taking contact, Sammi Silber of The District Standard reports Tuesday.

dylan demelo.note: DeMelo (lower body) is expected to be out of action for 4-6 weeks, Mitchell Clinton of the Jets' official site reports Thursday.

nick bjugstad.note: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
